This STATS 551 project estimates player-level penalty conversion probabilities with a hierarchical Beta–Binomial model. Partial pooling accounts for the small, uneven number of kicks taken by each player.

# Data preparation

The raw source is the [Penalty Kick Dataset (2020–2025)](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/rodrigoarede2003/penalty-kick-dataset-20202025). Each row records a kick, with outcomes coded as 1 for a goal and 0 otherwise.

```{r data-preparation}
library(tidyverse)

raw_data_path <- "real_data.csv"
clean_data_path <- "data/pen_clean.csv"

if (file.exists(raw_data_path)) {
  # The source uses Country for the league and spells goalkeeper as goalkeer.
  pen_clean <- read_csv(raw_data_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    janitor::clean_names() %>%
    rename(league = country, goalkeeper_name = goalkeer_name) %>%
    mutate(
      outcome_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(outcome)),
      y = case_when(
        outcome_num %in% c(0, 1) ~ as.integer(outcome_num),
        TRUE ~ NA_integer_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(y)) %>%
    transmute(
      y,
      season = as.character(season),
      league = str_squish(as.character(league)),
      player_id = as.integer(player_id),
      player_name = as.character(player_name),
      team_type = as.character(team_type),
      minute = as.integer(minute),
      home_goals = as.integer(home_goals),
      away_goals = as.integer(away_goals),
      kicker_foot = as.character(kicker_foot),
      kicker_side = as.character(kicker_side),
      goalie_side = as.character(goalie_side),
      goalkeeper_id = as.integer(goalkeeper_id),
      goalkeeper_name = as.character(goalkeeper_name)
    )
} else if (file.exists(clean_data_path)) {
  pen_clean <- read_csv(clean_data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  stop("Place real_data.csv next to this notebook or put the cleaned CSV at data/pen_clean.csv.", call. = FALSE)
}
```

# Prior predictive checks and model fitting

For player $j$, $y_j$ is the number of goals in $N_j$ attempts, with conversion probability $\theta_j$. The model uses a Binomial likelihood and a Beta population distribution parameterized by its mean $\mu$ and concentration $\kappa$. Stan fits the marginal Beta–Binomial model and draws each player's $\theta_j$ in generated quantities.

## Compare the two priors

### Initial concentration prior

\(\kappa \sim Gamma(0.1, 0.1)\)
```{r}
prior_mu_draw <- function(n) rbeta(n, 1.5, 1.5)
prior_kappa_draw <- function(n) rgamma(n, 0.1, 0.1)

prior_predict_one <- function(player_df) {
  J <- nrow(player_df)
  N <- player_df$N

  mu    <- prior_mu_draw(1)
  kappa <- prior_kappa_draw(1)

  alpha <- mu * kappa
  beta  <- (1 - mu) * kappa

  theta <- rbeta(J, alpha, beta)
  y_rep <- rbinom(J, size = N, prob = theta)

  tibble(
    rate_rep = y_rep / pmax(N, 1)
  )
}
```

```{r}
p_obs <- ggplot(player_df, aes(x = raw_rate)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05) +
  labs(title = "Observed data", x = NULL, y = "count") +
  theme_gray() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = "red")
  )

set.seed(321)

sim_plots <- lapply(1:11, function(s) {
  sim_dat <- prior_predict_one(player_df)

  ggplot(sim_dat, aes(x = rate_rep)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05) +
    labs(title = paste0("Simulated data ", s), x = NULL, y = "count") +
    theme_gray()
})

gridExtra::grid.arrange(
  grobs = c(list(p_obs), sim_plots),
  ncol = 4
)
```

### Revised concentration prior

\(\kappa \sim Gamma(4, 0.4)\)
```{r}
prior_mu_draw <- function(n) rbeta(n, 1.5, 1.5)
prior_kappa_draw <- function(n) rgamma(n, 4, 0.4)

prior_predict_one <- function(player_df) {
  J <- nrow(player_df)
  N <- player_df$N

  mu    <- prior_mu_draw(1)
  kappa <- prior_kappa_draw(1)

  alpha <- mu * kappa
  beta  <- (1 - mu) * kappa

  theta <- rbeta(J, alpha, beta)
  y_rep <- rbinom(J, size = N, prob = theta)

  tibble(
    rate_rep = y_rep / pmax(N, 1)
  )
}
```

```{r}
p_obs <- ggplot(player_df, aes(x = raw_rate)) +
```

## Stan model

```{r}
library(rstan)

rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)

stan_code_bb <- "
data {
  int<lower=1> J;
  int<lower=0> y[J];
  int<lower=0> N[J];
}
parameters {
  real<lower=0, upper=1> mu;
  real<lower=0> kappa;
}
transformed parameters {
  real<lower=0> alpha;
  real<lower=0> beta;
  alpha = mu * kappa;
  beta  = (1 - mu) * kappa;
}
model {
  // Prior on population mean
  mu ~ beta(1.5, 1.5);
  // Prior on concentration parameter:
  kappa ~ gamma(4, 0.4);

  // Beta-Binomial marginal likelihood
  for (j in 1:J) {
    target += lchoose(N[j], y[j])
              + lbeta(y[j] + alpha, N[j] - y[j] + beta)
              - lbeta(alpha, beta);
  }
}
generated quantities {
  vector[J] theta;
  vector[J] log_lik;

  for (j in 1:J) {
    // Posterior for player skills given mu,kappa and data
    theta[j] = beta_rng(alpha + y[j], beta + N[j] - y[j]);
    // pointwise log-lik for model comparison
    log_lik[j] = lchoose(N[j], y[j])
                 + lbeta(y[j] + alpha, N[j] - y[j] + beta)
                 - lbeta(alpha, beta);
  }
}
"
```

## Fit and summarize the population parameters

```{r}
stan_data <- list(
  J = nrow(player_df),
  y = player_df$y,
  N = player_df$N
)

fit_bb <- stan(
  model_code = stan_code_bb,
  data = stan_data,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 1,
  iter = 3000,
  warmup = 1500,
  seed = 321,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)

print(fit_bb, pars = c("mu", "kappa"))
```

# Posterior results and checks

## Player estimates and ranking

```{r}
library(rstan)

post <- rstan::extract(fit_bb)

theta_mat <- post$theta

stopifnot(!is.null(theta_mat))
cat("Theta matrix dims:", paste(dim(theta_mat), collapse = " x "), "\n")

# Posterior summaries for players
player_post <- tibble(
  player_name = player_df$player_name,
  attempts    = player_df$N,
  goals       = player_df$y,
  raw_rate    = player_df$raw_rate,
  post_mean   = apply(theta_mat, 2, mean),
  post_median = apply(theta_mat, 2, median),
  post_low    = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, probs = 0.10),
  post_high   = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, probs = 0.90),
  post_low95  = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025),
  post_high95 = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975)
) %>%
  arrange(desc(post_mean))

# Top 15 posterior mean
player_post %>% select(player_name, attempts, raw_rate, post_mean, post_low, post_high) %>% head(15)
```

### Top 15 by posterior mean

```{r}
player_post %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  mutate(player_name = fct_reorder(player_name, post_mean)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = post_mean, y = player_name)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = post_low, xmax = post_high), height = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Posterior Mean of Players",
    x = "Posterior Success Probability (80% interval)",
    y = ""
  )
```

## Posterior predictive checks by player

```{r}
post_predict_one <- function(player_df, fit_bb) {
  post <- rstan::extract(fit_bb)
  mu_all <- post$mu
  kappa_all <- post$kappa

  s <- sample(seq_along(mu_all), 1)

  mu <- mu_all[s]
  kappa <- kappa_all[s]

  alpha <- mu * kappa
  beta  <- (1 - mu) * kappa

  theta_post <- rbeta(
    n = nrow(player_df),
    shape1 = alpha + player_df$y,
    shape2 = beta  + player_df$N - player_df$y
  )

  y_rep <- rbinom(
    n = nrow(player_df),
    size = player_df$N,
    prob = theta_post
  )

  tibble(
    rate_rep = y_rep / pmax(player_df$N, 1)
  )
}
```

```{r}
p_obs <- ggplot(player_df, aes(x = raw_rate)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05) +
  labs(title = "Observed data", x = NULL, y = "count") +
  theme_gray() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = "red")
  )

set.seed(321)

sim_plots <- lapply(1:11, function(s) {
  sim_dat <- post_predict_one(player_df, fit_bb)

  ggplot(sim_dat, aes(x = rate_rep)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05) +
    labs(title = paste0("Simulated data ", s), x = NULL, y = "count") +
    theme_gray()
})

gridExtra::grid.arrange(
  grobs = c(list(p_obs), sim_plots),
  ncol = 4
)
```

## Posterior predictive check for the overall conversion rate


```{r}
set.seed(321)
post_predict_overall <- function(player_df, fit_bb, S = 1000) {
  post <- rstan::extract(fit_bb)
  mu_all <- post$mu
  kappa_all <- post$kappa

  idx <- sample(seq_along(mu_all), size = min(S, length(mu_all)), replace = FALSE)

  N <- player_df$N
  y <- player_df$y
  J <- nrow(player_df)

  overall_rep <- numeric(length(idx))

  for (i in seq_along(idx)) {
    s <- idx[i]

    mu <- mu_all[s]
    kappa <- kappa_all[s]

    alpha <- mu * kappa
    beta  <- (1 - mu) * kappa

    theta_post <- rbeta(
      n = J,
      shape1 = alpha + y,
      shape2 = beta  + N - y
    )

    y_rep <- rbinom(
      n = J,
      size = N,
      prob = theta_post
    )

    overall_rep[i] <- sum(y_rep) / sum(N)
  }

  tibble(overall_rate_rep = overall_rep)
}
```


```{r}
set.seed(321)
obs_overall <- sum(player_df$y) / sum(player_df$N)

overall_sim <- post_predict_overall(player_df, fit_bb, S = 1000)

ggplot(overall_sim, aes(x = overall_rate_rep)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = obs_overall, linetype = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior Predictive Check: Overall Conversion Rate",
    subtitle = "Dashed Line = Observed Overall Conversion Rate",
    x = "Replicated Overall Conversion Rate",
    y = "Count"
  )
```


```{r}
pp_pval <- mean(overall_sim$overall_rate_rep >= obs_overall)
pp_pval
```

## Shrinkage

```{r}
post <- rstan::extract(fit_bb)
theta_mat <- post$theta
if (is.null(theta_mat)) {
  stop("fit_bb does not contain theta in generated quantities.")
}
J <- ncol(theta_mat)

plot_df <- tibble(
  idx = 1:J,
  label = paste0("theta[", idx, "]"),
  attempts = player_df$N,
  goals = player_df$y,
  raw_rate = player_df$raw_rate,
  post_mean = apply(theta_mat, 2, mean),
  lo_95 = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, 0.05),
  hi_95 = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, 0.95),
  lo_50 = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, 0.25),
  hi_50 = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, 0.75)
)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(post_mean) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = label))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(y = label)) +
  # wide interval (90%)
  geom_segment(aes(x = lo_95, xend = hi_95, yend = label),
               linewidth = 1.0, alpha = 0.35) +
  # middle interval (50%)
  geom_segment(aes(x = lo_50, xend = hi_50, yend = label),
               linewidth = 3.0, alpha = 0.9) +
  # posterior mean (white dot)
  geom_point(aes(x = post_mean),
             shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 3, stroke = 1.0) +
  # raw rate (red dot)
  geom_point(aes(x = raw_rate),
             color = "red", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Shrinkage Plot: Raw vs Hierarchical Estimates",
    x = "Penalty Success Probability",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  xlim(0, 1) +
  theme_gray()
```

```{r}
plot_df <- tibble(
  idx = 1:J,
  player_name = player_df$player_name,
  attempts = player_df$N,
  goals = player_df$y,
  raw_rate = player_df$raw_rate,
  post_mean = apply(theta_mat, 2, mean),
  lo_95 = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, 0.05),
  hi_95 = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, 0.95),
  lo_50 = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, 0.25),
  hi_50 = apply(theta_mat, 2, quantile, 0.75)
) %>%
  arrange(post_mean)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(label_y = factor(player_name, levels = player_name))

few_threshold <- 2

few_df <- plot_df %>% filter(attempts <= few_threshold)

ggplot(few_df, aes(y = label_y)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lo_95, xend = hi_95, yend = label_y),
               linewidth = 1.0, alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lo_50, xend = hi_50, yend = label_y),
               linewidth = 3.0, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(x = post_mean),
             shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 3, stroke = 1.0) +
  geom_point(aes(x = raw_rate),
             color = "red", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Shrinkage Plot: Raw vs Hierarchical Estimates (N=1,2)",
    x = "Penalty Success Probability",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  xlim(0, 1) +
  theme_gray()
```
